requirements_to_testpoints.stimulus: Start with all buttons released and delta zero. Press each normalized selection input separately, including a press present on the first sampled step. Advance actual elapsed time through multiple 1000 ms display boundaries.
requirements_to_testpoints.oracle: Startup display command is 10000, LED is off, buzzer is silent, and no dispensing messages occur. D2/D3/D4 select items 1/2/3 immediately. The display starts with the selected item and alternates item/price every 1000 ms; prices are 1/2/3, so the two phases have equal numeric values for each item. CLK uses the authoritative remapped D8 binding and DIO uses D5.
requirements_to_testpoints.requirement_text:
设计一个自动售货机简化控制系统，使用按钮 D2、D3、D4 作为三种商品选择键，按钮 D7 作为确认键，TM1637（CLK=D4，DIO=D5）、蜂鸣器 D6、LED D13 和串口。系统维护商品价格和库存，用户按键选择商品后在数码管显示商品编号和价格；确认后若库存充足则串口输出 dispense:itemX，库存减一并蜂鸣提示，若库存不足则报警并显示错误代码。长按 D7 进入管理员模式，通过串口补货。
Disclosed bench parameters and transport: item prices1,2,3 and initial stock2 each. D2/D3/D4 select items1/2/3; short D7 release confirms a sale. A 2s D7 hold toggles admin mode without dispensing. In admin, serial_packet_input commands RESTOCK1,RESTOCK2,RESTOCK3 with codes1,2,3 accept COMMAND INTEGER frames at9600baud, payload0..9999 as added stock; only admin accepts restocking. Stock is bounded0..9999. Display alternates selected item/price each second, out-of-stock displays -1, accepted dispense emits dispense:itemX and a100ms beep. Keep stock, sale guards, hold timing and admin transitions in SysML.

requirements_to_testpoints.stimulus: For each item, perform three separate D7 press/release cycles shorter than 2000 ms, with no restocking. Observe each release, the following steps, and buzzer boundaries at 99 and 100 ms after an accepted sale.
requirements_to_testpoints.oracle: Only releases confirm. The first two releases each decrement that item's initial stock of 2, emit exactly one matching dispense:itemX line, and command 2000 Hz for 100 ms. The third release emits no dispense line, leaves stock at zero, displays -1, and commands a 1000 Hz alarm for 500 ms. A fresh selection clears the error display. No other item's stock changes.

requirements_to_testpoints.stimulus: Select an item and hold D7 across 1995, 2000, and 5000 ms. Release it, try a short confirmation in administrator mode, then perform another 2000 ms hold and release. Include a trace whose release sample crosses the 2000 ms threshold.
requirements_to_testpoints.oracle: The hold toggles administrator mode exactly once at 2000 ms and never dispenses on its release, including when the threshold is crossed at release. D13 indicates administrator mode. Short confirmations in administrator mode do not sell. A second long hold exits administrator mode without dispensing; subsequent short releases can sell.

requirements_to_testpoints.stimulus: Send valid RESTOCK1/2/3 quantity frames at 9600 baud outside and inside administrator mode. Exercise quantities 0 and 9999, multiple valid events, and retained packet values with io_7_valid false. Use encoded values command_code*10000+quantity and then leave administrator mode to sell.
requirements_to_testpoints.oracle: Only valid events processed in administrator mode add stock to the addressed item. Codes are 1/2/3 and quantities are decoded independently. Stock saturates at 9999 and never becomes negative. Invalid-event steps do not repeat additions. Restocked units become available for subsequent sales. No additional serial messages are emitted.

requirements_to_testpoints.stimulus: Use irregular nonnegative io_11 deltas, including display-period crossings and deltas longer than a buzzer duration. Hold selection and confirmation buttons over many steps.
requirements_to_testpoints.oracle: Timing uses actual elapsed deltas, not a fixed increment. Display phase preserves residual elapsed time across repeated cycles. Buzzer output becomes zero when its commanded duration expires. Held selection buttons do not repeatedly reset display timing, held confirmation does not repeatedly sell, and all report gates return false after their single sale step.
